name: Scourge
summary: Across Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas, the Scourge leaves kingdoms in ruin. The Burning Legion made it to weaken Azeroth before the Third War. Its undead, necromancers, and enslaved spirits broke free of demonic control. Now it wages war from Northrend and the corrupted Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Plague of Demonic Design
sections.body: The Burning Legion made the Scourge to destroy Azeroth. The demon lords bound the spirit of fallen orc shaman Ner'zhul to the Frozen Throne in Northrend and made him the Lich King. His terrifying telepathic power was meant to prepare the world for conquest. He sent the Plague of Undeath south into Lordaeron, where mortal traitors in the Cult of the Damned poisoned the grain. Those who died rose again as twisted thralls bound to his will.

sections.title: The Fall of the North
sections.body:
Prince Arthas Menethil heeded the Lich King's whispers, and the Scourge brought ruin to the north. Seeking vengeance in Northrend, Arthas claimed Frostmourne and lost his soul. He became the Scourge's foremost death knight. Returning home, he slew his father, King Terenas, butchered Capital City, and sent the undead across Lordaeron.

They swept through Darrowshire and Andorhal, slaughtered the Silver Hand paladins, and destroyed Dalaran to summon Archimonde. Across Quel'Thalas, they cut a dead scar to raise Kel'Thuzad as a lich.

sections.title: Betrayal and the Schism
sections.body:
Ner'zhul never meant to serve the Burning Legion forever. Through Arthas, he secretly brought about the Legion's defeat by urging Illidan Stormrage to kill the dreadlord Tichondrius in Felwood. Enraged, Kil'jaeden later ordered Illidan to destroy the Frozen Throne. Illidan's attack cracked the icy prison and weakened the Lich King's hold over his minions.

Led by the resurrected banshee Sylvanas Windrunner, a faction of free-willed undead broke away and took the name Forsaken. They seized the ruins of Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Present Threat
sections.body:
Even after the Frozen Throne was damaged and the Forsaken rebelled, the Scourge remains the deadliest force in the northern world. The lich Kel'Thuzad leads its forces in the field. Abominations, crypt fiends, and necromancers rule the corrupted Eastweald and Westweald, now called the Plaguelands.

From grim strongholds and blighted fields, the Scourge wages war against the Forsaken of the Undercity, the fanatics of the Scarlet Crusade, and the Alliance's remaining enclaves.

faq.answer: The Scourge is a vast host of undead thralls, necromancers, and warped beasts bound to the Lich King's mind. It seeks to destroy the living and make the fallen its servants.
The Lich King commands the Scourge from his Frozen Throne in Northrend. In Lordaeron's ruins, lieutenants such as the lich Kel'Thuzad direct its armies.

faq.q: How does the Scourge differ from the Forsaken?
aliases: why are undead fighting each other
faq.answer: The Scourge are undead dominated by the Lich King's will. The Forsaken were Scourge victims who regained their freedom when his power weakened. Led by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, they hate the Scourge and fight to destroy it.

faq.q: Why did the Scourge attack Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The Burning Legion ordered the Lich King to spread the Plague of Undeath across Lordaeron. It was meant to slaughter the people, weaken the Alliance, and clear resistance before the demons invaded Azeroth during the Third War.

faq.q: Who is the Cult of the Damned?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Damned is a mortal group founded by the archmage Kel'Thuzad. Its living human members chose to serve the Lich King for promises of dark magic and eternal life through undeath. They spread the tainted grain that began the plague.

faq.q: How was Prince Arthas corrupted by the Scourge?
aliases: why did arthas betray his people
faq.answer: Prince Arthas pursued the dreadlord Mal'Ganis to Northrend, obsessed with saving his kingdom from the plague. In desperation, he took Frostmourne, a cursed runeblade that stole his soul. The Lich King's whispers twisted him into the Scourge's foremost champion, and Arthas butchered his homeland.

angles.text: Every Forsaken was once enslaved by the Scourge and forced to butcher friends and kin until the Lich King's grip weakened. Destroying the Scourge is a fight for survival and deeply personal vengeance.
The Scourge destroyed humanity's greatest kingdom, slaughtered the Menethil line, and turned Lordaeron's heartland into a blighted wasteland.

The Scourge shattered the Knights of the Silver Hand when Prince Arthas turned on his mentors and murdered Uther the Lightbringer. For a paladin, cleansing the Scourge with the Holy Light is sacred duty.
Lordaeron's fall remains an open wound for the Alliance, driving its efforts to reclaim the Plaguelands and avenge the fallen.
The Forsaken have been accepted into the Horde, drawing the whole coalition into the ongoing war against the Lich King's remaining armies in the north.
